## Summary
What changed and why?

## Scope
- [ ] One focused vertical slice
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## Tests and evidence
List exact commands and results. Mark checks not run and explain why.

## Security and data integrity

- [ ] Secrets are not exposed in responses, logs, reports, or fixtures
- [ ] TLS/SSRF implications reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Source mailbox remains unchanged

## Checklist

- [ ] Static analysis/linting run where available
- [ ] Diff reviewed
- [ ] Limitations and follow-up work documented
